trigger: Siege night 2 (the probe). Hollows call from the dark; prowlers test the poles (enc_ch10_hollow_prowlers).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Night two. The lamp line holds. Every pole has a guard. Every guard has a flare.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You thinned them out at Dixie Valley. You don't know by how many. You only know they skipped the test. They're in a hurry.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Three a.m. A scream from the north fence. Then silence. Then the cooling-water line starts to whistle.

nodes.speaker: hollow
nodes.text: [From the dark past the north fence] Halvorsen's here. He's fine. Open the gate. Open the gate, Pearce.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Hackles up. Growling at the voice, not the fence. She won't go near the north gate.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: At the edge of the floodlight: a man-shape. No breath plume. Smiling with half its face.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Low shapes on all fours along the dark edge of the lights, testing each pole. Coyote-sized. Wrong.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: They got Halvorsen! Off the north pole! And the water line's split, Pearce! The pressure's dropping!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You clamp the line while Pete and two others stand over you with flares. Something takes a step into the light. Then back.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You find Halvorsen in the snow outside the fence. Alive. Dragged, then dropped when your flashlight hit them.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: By the time you're back, the water line's frozen. Unit 1 trips. It's four hours to restart.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Wraith sleeps against the control room door all day. She doesn't sleep at night anymore.]
